answer: Reputation-decay guarantor admission stops bulk fakes. A guarantor locks 70 credits, opens a thread per newcomer on a marble ledger, backs at most five. The thread starts at 100, falls 10 per idle epoch down a spiral; zero burns the bond. One fake costs 40 plus 70 locked; 1,000 need 200 guarantors and 110,000 for a 40,000 pool. One fake burns its guarantor's thread and exposes a rented-guarantor ring. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
